_readme: Alt text for every photo the site shows, keyed by its path under src/assets (the same keys as images.json, gallery.json and toppings.json). Say what the photo shows: start noodle photos with the product name, then the bowl, the toppings you can see and the packet if it's in shot. Never taste, heat, price or anything you can't see. Written from the photos themselves (MEON lead, 1 Nov 2026). npm run build stops if a photo on the site has no entry here.
